protocol.primary: Buy-share error in percentage points, UW bucket-volume-weighted mean
protocol.scope: Same 257 reconstructed matched buckets, 9/28 excludes entire 15:55–16:00
protocol.timing: First price-changing quote only; receipt delay 0..50ms; invalid first quote falls back. No later repair search. Large thresholds QQQ100/SPX50.
protocol.selectionBias: All analyses are exploratory on three previously inspected dates. Nested date splits isolate fitting labels, not the choice of feature families. No new-date performance guarantee.
